fee_notes: Primary fee is $65,000. Last fiscal year range $45,000–$65,000 reflects 10% discounts for military veterans or existing Maid Right franchisees (not combinable). Initial Technology Fee of $5,000 is additional and non-refundable. SBA financing option available with split payment.
raw_excerpt: The initial franchise fee ("Franchise Fee") for a Maid Right Business is $65,000... During our last fiscal year, we sold franchises for a Franchise Fee that ranged from $45,000 to $65,000.
